principles: Keep inventory completeness and topology proof contracts distinct.
Select behavior only from signed current state.
drivers: Unblock express Story B-0208 without false authorship.
Keep independent review and topology proof protections.

options.name: Select inventory-only dispatch for a verified current OPEN epoch
pros: Uses existing role and signed review-run machinery.
cons: Requires precise context selection and matching prompt instructions.

options.name: Require dedicated implementer lineage for every Story
cons: Contradicts supported express workflow and cannot truthfully reconstruct prior implementation.

chosen: Select inventory-only dispatch for a verified current OPEN epoch
rationale: Inventory completeness requires signed reviewer evidence, not a topology proof. Select the narrower existing review role responsibility from verified state, preserving the strict topology path elsewhere.

preMortem.scenario: Tampered or stale epoch selects inventory path
preMortem.mitigation: Use signed current epoch and current round, exercise invalid-signature and mismatched-round negatives.

preMortem.scenario: Inventory dispatch accidentally grants topology authority
preMortem.trigger: Copied businessCommit bindings or topology receipt prose
preMortem.consequence: Proof can be confused with completeness
preMortem.mitigation: Do not emit topology business binding; preserve receipt verification and assert prompts and process facts.
Retain review_inventory_critic_set lane completion and independent identity checks and existing tests.
